abstract: During the period January 1984 to December 1989, we treated 128 patients with ovarian neoplasms. 82.04% patients had benign tumors while the remaining 17.96% had ovarian cancer. Epithelial tumors were the commonest histological type (67.2%) followed by teratomas (17.19%). Most patients were of low parity, with 31.70% of patients with benign tumors and 11.11% of cancer patients, presenting also with infertility. An unfortunate feature of this study, as in most others from developing countries, is that patients since survival in such cases is a function of clinical stage and histologic type. One hundred and seventeen patients were treated by surgery (91.4%). Chemotherapy was used as an adjunctive treatment in 65.22% of cancer cases.
abstract_ja: 1984年1月から1989年12月までに、卵巣腫瘍の患者128例を治療した。患者の82.04%は良性腫瘍、残りの17.96%は卵巣癌であった。上皮性腫瘍が最も多い組織型(67.2%)で、次いで奇形腫(17.19%)であった。ほとんどの患者は経産回数が少なく、良性腫瘍の患者の31.70%、癌患者の11.11%が不妊を伴って受診した。多くの途上国からの報告と同様、この研究で残念な特徴は、生存が臨床病期と組織型の関数であることである。117例(91.4%)が手術で治療された。卵巣癌症例の65.22%では、補助療法として化学療法が用いられた。
